narrative.overview: A working engineer's console, not a marketing site. The default surface is a deep, almost-black blue-violet — a panel that disappears until you need it. Information is encoded in two chromatic readouts: emerald for primary signal, cyan for secondary readout. Chartreuse Marker is reserved infrastructure — defined in tokens but unused on the surface today. The rest is tonal layering. Nothing is decorative; everything either earns its place by carrying meaning or it isn't there. The personality is crafty, opinionated, precise. Type is set in Inter at a deliberate scale, never stretched, never faked. Lines breathe at 65–75ch. Spacing rhythm varies — sections alternate density so the page scans like a well-built interface, not like identical stacked blocks. Motion is purposeful: reveals honor prefers-reduced-motion, the prism hero animation is the single signature motion element on the site; no other section applies entrance animations by reflex.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default. Body is base-100 (deep blue-violet). No light mode; the surface is committed.
Tonal layering for depth, not shadows. Surfaces step through base-100/200/300 lightness.
Two chromatic accents active on the surface. Emerald Signal (primary) and Cyan Readout (secondary). Chartreuse Marker is reserved, not painted onto the page today.
Inter for prose, JetBrains Mono for technical labels. Contrast-axis pairing: humanist sans + engineering mono.
WCAG 2.1 AA enforced. Body text ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1, focus states visible, prefers-reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Emerald Signal and Cyan Readout are the active chromatic accents on the current surface. Chartreuse Marker is reserved infrastructure — defined in tokens for future exception, not painted onto the page today. State colors (info/success/warning/error) are reserved for state. Decoration never invents a fourth hue.

rules.name: The Twilight Commitment
rules.body: Body is Twilight 100, never warm-tinted cream, never white. The page is dark. This is a deliberate commitment, not a theme.

rules.name: The Inter-Only Prose Rule
rules.body: Body prose, captions, and display all use Inter. JetBrains Mono is opt-in per element where technical reading helps (tech tags, mono field labels, per-cell meta). No uppercase-tracked labels above sections — that's the AI kicker reflex, banned here.

rules.name: The Scale-By-Clamp Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline use clamp() so they breathe between mobile and desktop. Body uses fixed sizes. No fluid body text.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. State changes may shift surface tone or border, never fake depth with a drop shadow.

rules.name: The Resume Metric Exception
rules.body: The single hero-metric on the site lives in the Experience aside ({{ totalYears }}+ years shipping production products). It is the one sanctioned big-number callout. No other surface (hero, footer, about strip, technology section, future pages) may repeat the pattern; the same fact rendered elsewhere must be a sentence.

dos: Use oklch(20% 0.015 261.24) (Twilight 100) as the body background. Dark is the commitment.
Use Emerald Signal and Cyan Readout as the two chromatic accents. State colors are for state.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. The prism background and blur-text reveal crossfade or appear instantly when motion is reduced.
Set body line length to 65–75ch. Container padding scales by viewport, never over 6rem at 2xl.
Vary section spacing rhythm (sm/md/lg/xl). Sections should not all feel like the same height.
Keep cards flat. Surfaces step through base-100/200/300 lightness, not drop shadows.
Load Inter (sans) and JetBrains Mono (mono) from a privacy-respecting source.
Use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 and text-wrap: pretty on long prose.
Isolate metric callouts. The Resume Metric in the Experience aside is the one sanctioned hero-metric on the site. Anywhere else, render the same fact in prose.
donts: Use a cream / warm-tinted / off-white body background. The 2025–26 AI-portfolio reflex is banned here.

Add small uppercase-tracked kicker labels (ABOUT / PROCESS / WORK) above sections. The AI grammar is banned. Single-word lowercase mono field labels (e.g. work, stack, based in, reach me) are functional, not kickers, and are allowed.
Add a border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, list items, or callouts. Side-stripe accents are banned.
Use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient background). Emphasis comes from weight and size.

Use glassmorphism as a default. Backdrop-blur is reserved for hero-grade surfaces and on the current surface no element uses it. Don't add a glass card to feel premium — blur is a depth signal, not a decoration.
Lay out experiences or technologies as identical card grids. Vary surface treatment — experience is a timeline of rows, technologies is a grouped grid.
Use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as scaffolding reflex. A numbered sequence earns its place when the section IS a sequence; otherwise it doesn't appear.
Stretch or compress a typeface. If text doesn't fit, change the copy or the clamp — never the letter-spacing hack.
Add decorative animation that doesn't carry information. Motion is purposeful or it isn't there.
Mix fonts within the prose system. Inter for prose, JetBrains Mono for technical labels only.

Add another big-number hero-metric anywhere on the site outside the Experience aside. The pattern (giant colored number + small label + supporting stats) is the AI slop template; the single Resume Metric is the documented exception.
